src='''def transform(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    rc=max((v for v in cnt if v!=0), key=lambda v:cnt[v])
    mc=[v for v in cnt if v not in (0,rc)][0]
    rows=[i for i in range(h) if any(g[i][j]==rc for j in range(w))]
    cols=[j for j in range(w) if any(g[i][j]==rc for i in range(h))]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols)
    mp=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==mc]
    def ext_h(rows_set, cstart, cstop, step):
        for i in rows_set:
            rng = range(c1+1,w) if step==1 else range(0,c0)
            for j in rng: g[i][j]=rc
    right=[(i,j) for i,j in mp if j>c1]; left=[(i,j) for i,j in mp if j<c0]
    up=[(i,j) for i,j in mp if i<r0]; down=[(i,j) for i,j in mp if i>r1]
    rrows={i for i,j in right}; lrows={i for i,j in left}
    for i in range(r0,r1+1):
        if not right or i not in rrows:
            for j in range(c1+1,w): g[i][j]=rc
        if not left or i not in lrows:
            for j in range(0,c0): g[i][j]=rc
    ucols={j for i,j in up}; dcols={j for i,j in down}
    for j in range(c0,c1+1):
        if not up or j not in ucols:
            for i in range(0,r0): g[i][j]=rc
        if not down or j not in dcols:
            for i in range(r1+1,h): g[i][j]=rc
    return g
'''
